settings.heading: Cellulite was never a fat problem.
settings.intro: Thin women get it. Women who lift 5 days a week get it. For a lot of women it even looks worse after they lose weight. That's because it's about the tissue under your skin, and how well things move through it.
settings.callout_text: So creams were never going to fix it. They stay on the surface. And most cellulite creams are sold as cosmetics, which only have to prove they're safe, not that they work.
settings.callout_highlight: You didn't fail. You were handed tools that can't reach the problem.

settings.title: Your lymph has no pump.
settings.text: Blood has your heart. The fluid between your cells only moves when your muscles move.

settings.title: Your chair hits pause.
settings.text: 8–10 hours of sitting presses on your thighs and slows everything down. Like a garden hose with someone standing on it.

settings.title: Still tissue gets tight and puffy.
settings.text: Fluid sits. Tissue tightens. The dimpling shows more.

settings.heading: To change what you see on top, you have to move what's underneath.
settings.intro: Press. Lift. Release. Over and over. That's what a lymphatic massage therapist's hands do. It's also why one session costs $80–120.

settings.heading: Still have questions? Good.
settings.intro: You've been burned by big promises before. Here are straight answers.

settings.question: Does it hurt?
settings.answer: No. It feels like a deep massage, not a workout. Start on the lowest speed and only go up when it feels good. If anything hurts, ease off.

settings.question: I'm thin / I lift / I'm in menopause. Will it still work for me?
settings.answer: Cellulite shows up at every size and every age, because it's about the tissue under your skin, not your weight. Velnoxy works that tissue directly, so it fits your body as it is right now.

settings.question: How soon will I notice something?
settings.answer: Most women feel warm, lighter-feeling legs after the very first session. Changes in how your skin looks take steady use over several weeks. Everyone is different.

settings.question: I always quit routines. Why would this be different?
settings.answer: Because it doesn't ask for willpower. It's cordless, it rotates on its own, and you use it on the couch for 10 minutes. You were already sitting there anyway.

settings.question: Does it stall when I press harder?
settings.answer: [Confirm with supplier: motor torque under pressure.] Let the rollers do the work. A light, steady glide is all you need.

settings.question: Do I need the massage oil?
settings.answer: You can use any body oil. The Premium Massage Oil in the Essential Kit helps the nodes glide smoothly, so every session feels comfortable.

settings.question: What if it's not for me?
settings.answer: You have 30 days. Use it every night. If you don't love it, contact support@velnoxy.com for a full refund.
